The owned runner keeps explicit public zoneful preparation, default public fixture stability and zero adopted exhaustive:false exceptions. Complete provider/hook/helper/error source remains distinct: callback equality alone establishes no default-error, initialization, notification, lifecycle or advertised-minimum API/runtime equivalence. Actual supported framework and floor validation remains required.
